chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, and from another, from Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Allah is Great and Exalted. The servants are not able to describe Him, nor do they attain the reality of His greatness.
Visions do not comprehend Him, while He comprehends visions, and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.

And He is not described by 'how', nor by 'where', nor by location. How could I describe Him by 'how', when He is the One who originated the 'how' until it came to be 'how'? Thus 'how' came to be known only through what He originated for us of 'how'.
Or how could I describe Him by 'where', when He is the One who originated the 'where' until it came to be 'where'? Thus 'where' came to be known only through what He originated for us of 'where'.
Or how could I describe Him by location, when He is the One who originated location until it came to be location? Thus location came to be known only through what He originated for us of location.

So Allah, Blessed and Exalted, is within every place and outside every thing. Visions do not comprehend Him, while He comprehends visions. There is no god except Him, the Most High, the Magnificent, and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.

key_terms.اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ: the One subtle beyond perception and fully aware of all things
key_terms.الْأَبْصَارُ: visions or sights of created beings
key_terms.بِأَيْنٍ: by place or by asking 'where' about Him
key_terms.بِحَيْثٍ: by spatial location or situational placement
key_terms.بِكَيْفٍ: by modality or by asking 'how' about His being
key_terms.رَفِيعٌ: lofty and exalted above all created limitations
key_terms.عَظِيمٌ: immensely great beyond the full grasp of creation
key_terms.كُنْهَ: the true reality or ultimate depth of something

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explain that Allah cannot be described by how or where?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the transcendence and incomparability of Allah, teaching that created categories such as modality, place, and location cannot be applied to Him. It emphasizes that Allah is known through what He has made known, while human perception and description remain incapable of grasping the reality of His essence.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and from someone else, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Magnificent, Lofty. The servants have no ability upon describing Him<sup>azwj</sup>, nor would they reach His<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence

[6:103] Visions cannot comprehend Him, and He Comprehends (all) visions, and Heazwj is Aware of the subtleties, the Aware; and Heazwj can neither be described by the ‘how’, nor ‘where’; and ‘where’ and ‘how’ described Himazwj with the Qualitative State, and Heazwj is the Oneazwj Who Originated the ‘how’ until ‘how’ came to be. So the ‘how’ was recognised by what it was Originated for us from the Qualitative State.

Or, how can I<sup>azwj</sup> describe Him<sup>azwj</sup> with ‘where’, and He<sup>azwj</sup> is the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who Originated the ‘where’ until ‘where’ came to be. So the ‘where’ is recognised with what it was Originated for us from the ‘where’.

Of how can I<sup>asws</sup> describe Him<sup>asws</sup> with a position, and He<sup>azwj</sup> is the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who Originated the position, until ‘position’ came to be. So the ‘position’ is recognised with that it was Originated for us from the ‘position’.
So, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High is included in every place, and outside from everything.
[6:103] Visions cannot comprehend Him, and He Comprehends (all) visions. There is no god except Allahazwj. Heazwj is the Exalted, the Magnificent, and Heazwj is Aware of the subtleties, the Aware’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and others from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from Ali ibn Ibrahim from ‘Abdallah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Allah is Great and High. People cannot describe Him nor can they reach the depth of His Greatness.
‘ No mortal eyes can see Him, but He can see all eyes. He is All-kind and All-aware.’” [6:103]

He cannot be described by means of how and where. How can I describe Him by means of any condition? He Himself has created the conditions and how and so it came into being. We came to know conditions because of His designing them for us.
How can I describe Him by means of space? It is He, Who spaced the space so it became space. I, thus, came to know space by means of what He has made it into space.

How can I describe Him by means of positions when He Himself has given position to positions so it came into position. I, thus, came to know the position by means of what He has made to come into position.
Allah, the Holy, the Most High, is in every place but is out of everything. ‘ No mortal eyes can see Him, but He can see all eyes. He is All-kind and All-aware.’” [6:103]
